## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- LEFT JOIN with traffic session view detail table
-- JOIN key: view_event_id = event_id (同分区内)
SELECT t1.grass_date,
       t1.grass_region,
       t1.user_id,
       t2.platform,
       t2.app_version,
       t2.shop_id,
       SUM(duration_b) AS content_live_ads_view_duration
FROM (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, viewer_id AS user_id, view_event_id, duration_b
    FROM livestream.ls_mart_dwd_view_streaming_detail_di
    WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
      AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND tz_type = 'local'
) t1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, event_id, user_id, app_version, platform, shop_id
    FROM livestream.ls_mart_dwd_traffic_ls_session_view_detail_di
    WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
      AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND tz_type = 'local'
      AND operation = 'view'
      AND page_type = 'streaming_room'
      AND (user_id > 0 OR user_id IS NOT NULL)
) t2
  ON t1.grass_date = t2.grass_date
 AND t1.grass_region = t2.grass_region
 AND t1.view_event_id = t2.event_id
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 直播观看时长聚合 (all 3 files, identical pattern)

```sql
create or replace temporary view content_user_view_duration as
select t1.grass_date,
       t1.grass_region,
       t1.user_id,
       t2.platform,
       t2.app_version,
       t2.shop_id,
       sum(duration_b) as content_live_ads_view_duration,
       -1 as item_id,
       -1 as location,
       'Live Streaming' as common_feature
from (
    select grass_date, grass_region, viewer_id as user_id, view_event_id, duration_b
    from livestream.ls_mart_dwd_view_streaming_detail_di
    where grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
      and grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and tz_type = 'local'
) t1
left join (
    select grass_date, grass_region, event_id, user_id, app_version, platform, shop_id
    from livestream.ls_mart_dwd_traffic_ls_session_view_detail_di
    where grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
      and grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and tz_type = 'local'
      and operation = 'view'
      and page_type = 'streaming_room'
      and (user_id > 0 or user_id is not null)
) t2
  on t1.grass_date = t2.grass_date
 and t1.grass_region = t2.grass_region
 and t1.view_event_id = t2.event_id
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6;
```
